cases.why_closed: Reason not stated. The parent 2024-006641PRJ holds only the application, the Conditional Use supplement, plans and an intake checklist (last changed 2024-12-09). No hearing, motion, staff report or letter. Status "Closed - Withdrawn" 2025-01-15, about six months after filing. Likely reason (inferred from the code, as N09): the request as filed, a new ABC Type 21 at a store in the Mission Alcoholic Beverage SUD, had no path, because the SUD allows no new Liquor Store and lets a grocery take only a licence transferred from inside the SUD (§ 249.60(a), (b)(2)). Context only, from the local copy of the ABC licence data: a Type 20 off-sale beer and wine licence (Casa Guadalupe Supermarket 2) was issued at this address on 2025-07-16 by transfer from licence 20-394431. Sub-rule labels differed; A's kept. Why closed: both readings say the request as filed had no path; B recommended recording a regulatory problem. Settled as N09 of the 40: why_class use_not_permitted, regulatory_problem yes, basis inferred (cases.yaml updated). Record facts from the application and CU supplement, which B read (cached at reader B's download folder) and A did not; the adjudicator re-read the application's land use table (Retail/Commercial GSF '10,976 app.', one storey) and project details (Change of Use and 'ABC License' ticked; New Construction not ticked).
cases.notes: The application, CU supplement and plans in 2024-006641PRJ were not read (not cached; not downloaded); they would say what the store is and its size. The withdrawal reason is not stated; 'no path under § 249.60' is my inference. Whether the Planning Department would read a grocery with a Type 21 as a Liquor Store depends on the alcohol display share, which is not in the file. Second reader: Floor area is handwritten; read as 10,976. The narrative figure may be '+10,000' or '26,000'; the table is clearer. Second reader: Whether the operator would have been classed as a General Grocery or a Liquor Store was never decided by Planning.
cases.open_point: Floor area is handwritten ('10,976 app.'); the narrative may read '+10,000' or '26,000'. The table is clearer and is used.
cases.correct_pathway: As filed (a new Type 21 at a store in the Mission Alcoholic Beverage SUD) no path is open: a new Liquor Store is prohibited and groceries are eligible only for licences transferred from inside the SUD. If the store is a grocery of 5,000 sq ft or less, the open path is a Type 20 transferred from inside the SUD with a Conditional Use (§ 249.60(b)(2)(A)); if larger, a transfer from inside the SUD under (b)(2)(B). What happened next matches a Type 20 path (Type 20 issued 2025-07-16 by transfer), but no Planning record for it is in the local copy, so which path was used is not shown.
